entities.summary: Elie Tahari is an Israeli-American fashion designer and entrepreneur. He is best known for founding the Elie Tahari ready-to-wear fashion brand and co-founding Theory. He is the chairman of Elie Tahari, Ltd. and his son Jeremey is CEO and creative director. His company is headquartered in New York City, with stores located throughout the world.
